description: A six-panel composite of optical micrographs (OM) documenting the microstructural evolution of Fe-28Mn-8Al-1C low-density steel with increasing cryogenic rolling (CR) reduction. (a) Undeformed: equiaxed grains with straight grain boundaries and scattered annealing twins; scale bar 20 µm. (b) CR30%: grains begin to elongate along RD, with yellow-arrow labels "Slip band" and "Intersection of slip bands"; RD arrow and 20 µm scale bar. (c) CR50%: flattened/banded elongated grains with dense slip bands labelled "Elongated grain" and "Slip band"; RD arrow, 20 µm scale bar. (d) CR70%: more severely elongated grains with heavier, darker slip-band contrast; labels "Elongated grain" and "Slip band"; RD arrow, 20 µm scale bar. (e) CR90%: fibrous, heavily banded appearance labelled "Fiber textures"; RD arrow, 20 µm scale bar. (f) CR90% at higher magnification (1 µm scale bar) showing intersecting slip bands of two orientations, labelled "Intersection of slip bands"; RD arrow. Together the panels show a progressive transition from equiaxed austenite to a fibrous, slip-band-dominated rolled structure with increasing CR. All panels are greyscale OM; grain-size values are not printed on the images.

subfigures.description: Grayscale OM of undeformed steel: equiaxed grains with straight grain boundaries and a few annealing twins dispersed in the interiors; 20 µm scale bar, no RD arrow.
OM of CR30% steel: grains elongating along RD, with yellow-arrow annotations 'Slip band' and 'Intersection of slip bands'; RD arrow and 20 µm scale bar.
OM of CR50% steel: flattened/banded elongated grains with abundant slip bands, annotated 'Elongated grain' and 'Slip band'; RD arrow and 20 µm scale bar.
OM of CR70% steel: heavily elongated grains with denser, darker slip bands, annotated 'Elongated grain' and 'Slip band'; RD arrow and 20 µm scale bar.
OM of CR90% steel: strongly fibrous, banded microstructure annotated 'Fiber textures'; RD arrow and 20 µm scale bar.
Higher-magnification OM of CR90% steel (1 µm scale bar) showing intersecting slip bands of two different orientations, annotated 'Intersection of slip bands'; RD arrow.

observations.observation: The figure comprises six grayscale optical micrographs labelled (a)-(f), all of the same Fe-28Mn-8Al-1C steel at different cryogenic rolling reductions.
Panel (a) shows the undeformed state with equiaxed grains and straight grain boundaries, plus a few annealing twins within the grains.
Panels (b), (c), (d) and (e) each carry a yellow RD arrow indicating the rolling direction; scale bars of 20 µm are printed in (a)-(e).
Panel (b) is annotated 'Slip band' and 'Intersection of slip bands', showing slip bands emerging inside grains that already elongate along RD at CR30%.
Panels (c) and (d) are annotated 'Elongated grain' and 'Slip band', with grain elongation and slip-band density visibly increasing as CR rises from 50% to 70%.
Panel (e) is annotated 'Fiber textures' and shows a strongly fibrous, banded microstructure at CR90%.
Panel (f) is also CR90% but at higher magnification (1 µm scale bar) and is annotated 'Intersection of slip bands', showing two sets of slip bands crossing at different orientations.
The caption states panel labels: a) undeformed, b) CR30%, c) CR50%, d) CR70%, and e,f) CR90%.
The citing text states that the undeformed steel displays an equiaxed grain morphology with an average grain size of ≈40.3 μm.
The citing text states that at 30% CR the equiaxed grains elongate along RD and numerous slip bands emerge, with intersecting slip bands in some grains indicating nonuniform plastic deformation.

The citing text states that at 50% CR the deformation along RD intensifies, slip-band density increases, flattened/banded grains appear and significant deformation twinning is present; at 70% larger dislocation cells form and twin density decreases.

The citing text states that after 90% thickness reduction the grains elongate further along RD forming a fibrous appearance, with intersecting slip bands, wave-like microshear bands and a refined nanoscale grain structure.
